summary: Iteration 153 tested RealmLife housing/beacons/privacy backend + desktop & mobile UX. All 8 backend pytest cases passed (housing per-user + founder, beacons list without identity leaks, world/home per-lot spawn vs founder origin, access-check private_property, entry-request idempotent no 500, property inbox). Desktop /realmlife loads Three.js world after ENTER REALMLIFE (life-sim-runtime + canvas render, needs panel visible, HOME/POV/CUTAWAY/PROPERTY/EXIT text buttons render, 'Welcome home.' toast shown, no fatal console errors). Mobile 390x844: rotate popup shows and NOT NOW dismisses it with sessionStorage realmlife_rotate_dismissed=1; needs collapsed to icon (realmlife-needs-toggle) and expands to realmlife-needs-panel then minimizes; joystick, INTERACT (realmlife-interact-btn) and JUMP all visible bottom-inset; top bar DAY visible.

ui_bugs.issue: HOME / CUTAWAY (FULL) / PROPERTY / EXIT buttons on desktop lack data-testid attributes (realmlife-home-btn, realmlife-cutaway-btn, realmlife-property-btn, realmlife-exit-btn). Buttons are clickable but not test-selectable via testid on desktop.
Mobile JUMP button lacks data-testid (e.g. realmlife-jump-btn). Visible on screen but not testable via testid.
Mobile HOME/MENU top-right buttons lack data-testid.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to desktop HUD buttons in LifeSimRuntime.jsx: realmlife-home-btn, realmlife-cutaway-btn (FULL), realmlife-property-btn, realmlife-exit-btn, realmlife-pov-btn, realmlife-normal-btn (or reverse-btn), realmlife-jump-btn. This unblocks reliable automated regression testing of the specific flows called out in the review request (e.g. click HOME then assert no 'Unable to return home').
critical_code_review_comments: Beacon endpoint correctly omits owner identity fields (username/user_id/email) — verified in test.
Founder housing correctly returns founder=true with lot_seq=null and world/home spawn at (0, 17.6).
Member auditcheckreal correctly gets home_anchor.lot_seq == property.city_lot_seq and spawn matches anchor x within 1.0 unit — per-lot ownership works end-to-end.
Entry-request is idempotent and no longer throws the previous ObjectId 500.
Access-check returns allowed=false reason=private_property for property-000001 as expected.
test_credentials: auditcheckreal / Password1$ (member, owns property-000002 lot 2 x=-104 z=37); stealth / Password1$ (Founder, origin lot); tftwo / pass1234 (second member, not exercised in this run since read-only checks sufficed).
seed_data_creation: None; used existing pending entry-request from prior runs to validate idempotency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent adds missing data-testids on desktop HUD, a follow-up run can programmatically click the HOME testid and assert no 'Unable to return home' toast. On mobile every target testid from the review request already exists (realmlife-rotate-popup, realmlife-rotate-notnow, realmlife-rotate-btn, realmlife-needs-toggle, realmlife-needs-panel, realmlife-needs-minimize, realmlife-joystick, realmlife-interact-btn, life-sim-runtime, life-sim-canvas). Login must use POST /api/auth/login with {"email":"<username>","password":...} and access_token — the /login form redirects to /signup on cold load; use the in-page fetch pattern used here, or click the 'Log in' tab explicitly. The /realmlife route shows a landing/customization page first for members; click 'ENTER REALMLIFE' button to enter the game (Three.js world takes ~15-20s to build).
rca of the issue: n/a — no functional bugs found this iteration. Only gap is missing data-testids on desktop HUD which impedes automated regression coverage but is not a runtime defect.
